llm_response.reason: The website displays several major scam indicators: guaranteed high returns (promises of up to 80% ROI), urgency and psychological enticement tactics, ambiguous or missing company details, reliance on cryptocurrency payment methods, instant withdrawal claims, copy trading portrayed as failproof, unverified and likely fake testimonials, and vague licensure information. These fit common traits found in cryptocurrency scam sites, particularly around investment fraud where users are lured by unrealistic ROI figures and false claims of secure, instant withdrawals.
